title: How to Set Up Course Completion Behavior in Thrive Apprentice

steps.raw_text: In your WordPress dashboard, navigate to **Thrive Dashboard** > **Thrive Apprentice**.
Click the **Courses** tab in the left sidebar.
Open the course you want to configure by clicking on it.
Locate the **Completion** section in the course settings panel.
steps.context: section in the course settings panel

steps.raw_text: In the **Completion** section, select your preferred redirect option.
steps.context: section, select your preferred redirect option

steps.raw_text: If you chose **Redirect to a Specific URL**, enter the destination URL in the field that appears.
steps.context: enter the destination URL in the field that appears

steps.raw_text: If you chose **Redirect to Next Course**, select the target course from the dropdown.
steps.context: select the target course from the dropdown

steps.raw_text: Click **Save** to apply your settings.
In the **Completion** section, look for the **Completion Message** option.
steps.context: section, look for the Completion Message option

steps.raw_text: Toggle it on to enable a message overlay or notification.
Enter your congratulations text. For example: "Congratulations! You've completed the course. Download your certificate below."
steps.target: Congratulations! You've completed the course. Download your certificate below.

steps.raw_text: Customize the appearance and style of the message if options are available.
Click **Save** to apply.
Make sure a certificate template is assigned to the course (see [How to Issue Course Completion Certificates](8-01-certificates.md)).
In the **Completion** section, enable the option to display the certificate or include a download link in the completion message.
steps.context: section, enable the option to display the certificate or include a download link

steps.raw_text: Click **Save** to apply.
In the **Completion** section, look for the **Next Course** option.
steps.context: section, look for the Next Course option

steps.raw_text: Select the course you want to recommend from the dropdown list.
Optionally, customize the call-to-action text that appears alongside the suggestion (e.g., "Ready for the next step? Start Course 2!").
steps.target: Ready for the next step? Start Course 2!

steps.raw_text: Click **Save** to apply.
